editorial_notes: The frozen document wrapper contains only the unchanged original module title and metadata,15elements/11slots. Content and glossary are explicitly excluded in source metadata. This is a source selection, not a complete module document.

Translate both source title occurrences, the learning-objective introduction and all six objectives. Preserve md:content-id and md:uuid byte-exact as protected slots s002/s011; never broaden this into a generic English passthrough.
Read the complete actual English and Indonesian opening fields. Both have the same six objectives in the same order and identical protected identifiers.

Use witnessed సహజ సంఖ్యలు/పూర్ణాంకాలు and existing B001–B008 course conventions. Reread TS6 PDF26/27 OCR/images for number sets/line, TS2 PDF42 OCR for place versus contribution, and TS6 PDF14 OCR/image for specified-place rounding wording.

As in B003/B008, the source's place-value questions supply place-name answers. The third Telugu objective explicitly identifies the occupied place; the separate bridge retains and explains the original English phrase and distinguishes numerical contribution.
The naming/writing objectives explicitly distinguish అక్షరాలలో from అంకెలలో. This does not replace international periods with Indian grouping or introduce a Telugu grammar rule.

TE-B010 is a production identifier for the previously omitted module opening, not an instruction to teach it after the glossary. Reader navigation should identify its opening role. The small added bridge links the six prior teaching units, available rechecks and B002's source Try It; B002 has no separate recheck bank. No new assessment bank or score.
Completion of this selection does not assert that all m81243 units passed review. Earlier collection Preface and Introduction remain outside B001–B010 and pending.
